text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the soba yesterday. It was 
quick and easy to eat, just what I needed.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Haha, glad to hear it! I'll hit some more 
for ya anytime!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...I'll help next time. Teach me, and I'll 
do it too.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
What are you looking so surprised for? You 
saying I'm not gonna be any help?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! That's not what I meant! I'm 
super happy! Really thrilled! ...But—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, you sure you're fine with me 
teaching you? Others have told me my 
teaching style is kinda terrifying."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? Why would I be scared? I'm higher 
on the totem pole, after all. Don't mess 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Heh, hahaha! Oh, right, of course! It's 
you and me, after all!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, time for you to do the dough 
rolling! If you're doing it, give it your 
all!!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Got it? Curl your hands like cat paws, and 
firmly push the rolling pin out like this!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, just whenever you're ready to 
do it. Sheesh.
